sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 4XL.
Recovers 5 Cost.
Target: yourself. Increases max HP by S for 20 seconds.
The greater the current HP is when attacking, the greater the increase of Ability Power up to a max of 5XL.
Increases physical and magic attack Ability success value by M.
Ability Power scales with the number of Dark elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 6XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Dark elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
